zh.title: 國防部：偵獲共機6架次、共艦12艘 5架次越中線進入西南及東部空域
zh.summary: 國防部11月23日公布，自22日上午6時至23日上午6時，偵獲共機6架次，其中5架次逾越海峽中線進入西南及東部空域，另有共艦12艘在臺海周邊活動。
body: 國防部11月23日上午公布中共解放軍臺海周邊海、空域動態：自11月22日上午6時至23日上午6時，偵獲共機6架次，其中5架次逾越海峽中線進入西南及東部空域，另有共艦12艘持續在臺海周邊活動。國防部表示，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
國防部同時公布的空域活動示意圖列出三批共機的時段與機種：上午6時30分至下午5時05分有無人機2架次，上午7時45分至11時35分有輔戰機及無人機2架次，上午10時05分至下午5時30分有直升機2架次。
前一個統計日（11月21日上午6時至22日上午6時），國防部通報偵獲共機24架次，其中17架次逾越中線進入中部及西南空域，另有共艦11艘、公務船1艘及空飄氣球2顆。

en.title: Taiwan detects 6 PLA aircraft sorties and 12 naval vessels; 5 sorties cross the median line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected six PLA aircraft sorties in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 23, five of which crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into southwestern and eastern airspace, along with 12 PLA Navy vessels.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on November 23 that it detected six sorties of People's Liberation Army (PLA) aircraft between 6 a.m. on November 22 and 6 a.m. on November 23. Five of them crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered southwestern and eastern airspace. Twelve PLA Navy vessels were also operating around Taiwan. The ministry said the armed forces monitored the situation and responded with mission aircraft, naval vessels and shore-based missile systems.

The ministry's accompanying chart lists three groups of aircraft by time and type: two sorties of unmanned aerial vehicles between 6:30 a.m. and 5:05 p.m., two sorties of support aircraft and UAVs between 7:45 a.m. and 11:35 a.m., and two helicopter sorties between 10:05 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.

In the previous reporting period, from 6 a.m. on November 21 to 6 a.m. on November 22, the ministry reported 24 aircraft sorties, 17 of which crossed the median line into central and southwestern airspace, as well as 11 naval vessels, one official ship and two balloons.

facts.claim: Between 06:00 on November 22 and 06:00 on November 23, Taiwan detected 6 PLA aircraft sorties (5 crossing the median line into southwestern and eastern airspace) and 12 PLA Navy vessels.
The ministry's chart lists 2 UAV sorties (0630-1705), 2 support aircraft/UAV sorties (0745-1135) and 2 helicopter sorties (1005-1730).
CNA reported the same figures from the ministry's announcement.
The previous period recorded 24 sorties (17 across the median line), 11 vessels, one official ship and two balloons.
